scholarships.name: European Union: Erasmus+ Mobility Project for Higher Education Teachers and Staff
scholarships.description: The Erasmus+ individual mobility project is not only aimed at students but also at university teachers and members of staff at higher education institutions in Germany and other European states. The programme is intended to sponsor mobility of teaching, education and training within 33 European countries, or Erasmus+ programme countries, and in the specified [Erasmus+ partner countries](https://eu.daad.de/infos-fuer-hochschulen/programmlinien/infos-zu-programm-und-partnerlaendern/de/45673-erasmus-partnerlaender/) around the world. For further information applicants should contact the [International Office](https://eu.daad.de/service/ansprechpartner/erasmus-plus-hochschulkoordinatoren/de/46403-erasmus-hochschulkoordinatoren/) of their home institution.
scholarships.deadlineText: The [International Office](https://eu.daad.de/service/ansprechpartner/erasmus-plus-hochschulkoordinatoren/de/46403-erasmus-hochschulkoordinatoren/) of your home institution of higher education will provide you with the relevant application deadlines.
scholarships.sourceQuote: Erasmus+ mobility activities further individual training and education of all staff at higher education institutions.
